title: Back to top
summary: A floating button that appears once the reader is well down the page and scrolls the page (or a named scroller) back to the top, smoothly unless reduced motion is on.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Scroll distance in px past which the button appears; below 0 it is always shown (previews, short pages).

a11y: A real button with a text label; after scrolling, focus moves to the top of the scroller so keyboard users are not left at the bottom.
mobile: 44px tall; clears the device safe area.
